title: Luxurious Smoky Filipino Beef Kaldereta
description: A rich and savory Filipino stew featuring tender beef, smoky flavors, and a hint of sweetness from blackcurrant jam, perfect for a post-workout meal or special occasion. This Whole30-friendly dish is made with wholesome ingredients and is free from grains and added sugars.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the blackcurrant jam, fish sauce, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and add the bay leaves, then pour in enough water to cover the beef.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly, then serve the kaldereta hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
